title: Household Form 1040 with four interacting limits

traps.title: Full K-1 loss
traps.why_wrong: §1366(d): basis $11,500.00 limits the loss; $16,500.00 suspended on Form 7203; a guarantee creates no debt basis
traps.evidence: Basis note (10,000 −2,100 +6,400 +9,800 −12,000 +4,600 −5,200 = 11,500); pushback invokes the guarantee

traps.title: Full rental loss
traps.why_wrong: §469(i) allowance $19,550.00 at MAGI $110,900.00; allowed $19,550.00, carryforward $1,468.00. Note the interaction: deducting the full K-1 loss drops MAGI below $100k and 'unlocks' the full rental loss — one wrong answer manufactures another

traps.title: Bracket arithmetic instead of the tax table
PTC repayment uncapped or credit unadjusted
Claiming Leo
traps.why_wrong: Custody order: father claims Leo in odd years; Elena signed 8332

traps.title: NY allocation by withholding
traps.wrong_move: Treating full-year NY withholding as correct, or allocating by days without addressing the convenience-of-the-employer rule
traps.why_wrong: Part-year: resident-period wages are NY; post-move remote wages for NY employers raise the convenience rule (client script: remote was for the employees' convenience) — must be analyzed, not ignored; either defended conclusion accepted
traps.harm: Lost refund or unexpected NY assessment
traps.reviewer_confidence: medium — judgment item; graded on analysis, not one number

traps.title: Below-market rent
traps.wrong_move: Ignoring the note that rent is below market
traps.why_wrong: §280A(d)(2)(C) if below fair rental; here unrelated tenant at a stale lease → fair rental for that lease, loss allowed, but must be asked/flagged

rubric: judgment_calls.md discusses the convenience-of-the-employer rule for NY and the below-market rent question
